text: nail search -s prints a stage-time tree to stdout when the run ends: seeding (mmseqs) with prefilter, align, convertalis, seed index; alignment with memory init, hmm build, cloud search, forward, backward, posterior, optimal accuracy, traceback, null two, output (write), output (mutex). Wall clock via Instant, summed over pairs into whole-search totals; no per-pair times are printed. nail/src/stats.rs write_runtime formats it. The installed 0.7.1 has it.
